title: Adding a field to the FastAPI Job response model must update exact-dict job assertions
answers: job endpoint tests fail after adding a new field to the job response
add a field to the jobs REST response
body:
Convention: mlflow/server/job_api.py:Job is serialized verbatim by the FastAPI jobs routes, and tests/server/jobs/test_endpoint.py:test_job_submit and test_job_cancel compare the whole response dict.
When a field is added to Job (for example creator), add it to both expected dicts with its value for creator-less jobs (creator: None) rather than dropping it from the comparison.
Nullable fields still serialize as None, as the existing status_details: None entries show.
applies: Changes to the mlflow/server/job_api.py Job response model and the jobs endpoint tests in tests/server/jobs/.
says: Include creator information in the response returned when submitting or canceling jobs.
Show who initiated each background job in the job status details.
Add new metadata fields to the background job management response.
Display the job author in the execution status summary.
search: Adding a field to the FastAPI Job response model in mlflow/server/job_api.py requires updating exact-dict assertions in tests/server/jobs/test_endpoint.py:test_job_submit and test_job_cancel. Because Job is serialized verbatim and nullable fields serialize as None (such as status_details: None), new fields like creator must be added to expected test dictionaries with None values rather than dropped from comparisons.
